title: License/provenance gate (fail-closed; per-source verification + provenance manifest)
context: Open-Spending-Explainers uses only open/PD/CC/open-gov-licensed data. Ingesting a source with an unverified or incompatible license would violate reuse terms and undermine the project's legal and ethical foundations. The license/provenance gate is a hard product requirement built before any source is ingested. It must be fail-closed: no verified license means no ingest. OSM/ODbL-derived geodata requires special isolation from the CC-BY corpus. Depends on repo-002 (skeleton).
objective: Implement the license/provenance gate module (lib/provenance) as specified in PLAN.md: fail-closed per-source license verification, full provenance record per source (publisher, jurisdiction, dataset name, URL, retrieval date, sha256 snapshot checksum, license, permits-derivatives flag, legal-status note), a provenance manifest emitted alongside each dataset, and ODbL/OSM isolation handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Fail-closed: any source without a verified open/PD/CC/open-gov reuse-and-derivatives license is rejected at ingest; no proprietary, access-controlled, or paywalled sources are accepted
Records full provenance per source: publisher, jurisdiction, dataset name, URL, retrieval date, sha256 snapshot checksum, license, permits-derivatives flag, and legal-status note
Emits a provenance manifest alongside each dataset/explainer companion, listing all sources with their provenance records
OSM/ODbL handling: any OSM-derived geodata is tagged ODbL, isolated from the CC-BY corpus, and attributed; the gate is tested for ODbL isolation
Per-publisher OCDS license verification is implemented (OCDS is a format, not a license; each publisher's terms are checked individually)
Gate is tested with fixtures covering accepted and rejected sources; PR merged with green CI and maintainer plus public-finance expert review passed
output: A merged PR containing the license/provenance gate module (lib/provenance) with fail-closed per-source verification, full provenance record and manifest emission, ODbL/OSM isolation, and tests — the gate that all ingest tasks must pass through before any source enters the pipeline.
